'''Bacta distribution centers''', located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], were often targeted for terrorist bombings by the [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]], led by [[Kirtan Loor]], thus making it even more difficult for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to deal with the [[Krytos virus]] that was killing thousands on Coruscant at the time.
